title: Draft Incident
description: A candidate incident captured from a news article or other source, awaiting human review. This is deliberately a separate, looser schema from the canonical Incident schema in /schemas/incident.schema.json — draft content is never treated as canonical knowledge, and never lives in /data. See /docs/ingestion-pipeline.md.

id.description: Draft-namespace identifier, distinct from the 'incident-' namespace used once promoted.

raw_excerpt.description: Verbatim excerpt captured from the source, kept as the ground truth the draft was built from.

extraction_method.description: How the suggested_incident content below was drafted. AI-assisted drafts require human review before promotion exactly like human ones — this field is for transparency, not for skipping review.

suggested_incident.description: The reviewer's/extractor's candidate content for the eventual canonical Incident record. Not schema-validated against incident.schema.json until promotion, since it is expected to be incomplete or provisional at this stage.

reviewer.description: Name/handle of the human reviewer. Required before status can be 'approved' (enforced by the promote script, not this schema, since JSON Schema conditionals here would be harder to read than a clear runtime check).

confidence_assigned.description: The confidence level the reviewer assigns to the promoted record. Required before promotion.
